items.name: Tom Ford Soleil Brûlant Eau de Parfum 250ml
items.description: Soleil Brûlant (250 ml) captures the high-shine brilliance of the golden sun beaming on a private oasis. Sun-kissed citrus mingles with spices – giving way to an ornate and regal floral heart – while orange flower absolute and black honey release a seductive vapor, melting into the burnished warmth of amber. The warmth of amber and mix of florals render this fragrance original. Soleil Brûlant is addictive…the boldest version of Soleil.

items.name: Creed Les Royales Exclusives Sublime Vanille Eau de Parfum 250ml
items.description: Fragrance connoisseurs will appreciate this soft Oriental blend of vanilla and Tonka bean finished with sparkling notes of lemon. It is offered in a hand-blown Pochet glass bottle etched with Creed's crest: art object and eau de parfum in one.

items.name: Tom Ford Vanille Fatale Eau de Parfum 250ml

VANILLE FATALE evokes the ingredient’s alter-ego – a beguiling, richly cinematic and deeply seductive scent is an eclipse of dark woods, addictive coffee absolute and roasted barley. Luxe vanilla resinoid captivates at the fragrance’s core as an entrancing force.

items.description: The most legendary and expensive wine in the world. This 1945 vintage from the smallest Grand Cru vineyard in Burgundy represents the pinnacle of Pinot Noir. Only 600 bottles were produced.

items.name: Macallan 1926 Fine & Rare 60 Year Old
items.description: The world's most expensive whisky ever sold at auction. This 60-year-old single malt from Macallan's Fine & Rare collection was bottled in 1986. Only 40 bottles were ever released.

items.name: Château Margaux 1787
items.description: One of the oldest and most valuable wines in existence. This 1787 vintage from Château Margaux was owned by Thomas Jefferson and bears his initials carved into the bottle. A piece of wine history.

items.name: Hennessy Beaute du Siecle Cognac
items.description: Ultra-rare cognac created to celebrate Hennessy's 200th anniversary. This exceptional blend features eaux-de-vie from the 19th century, housed in a Baccarat crystal decanter designed by architect Daniel Libeskind.

items.name: Penfolds Grange Hermitage 1951
items.description: The inaugural vintage of Australia's most famous wine. This 1951 Grange represents the birth of modern Australian winemaking and is considered one of the most important wines in Australian history.

items.name: Dalmore 64 Trinitas
items.description: Ultra-rare single malt whisky aged for 64 years. Only three bottles were ever created, making this one of the most exclusive whiskies in existence. Features whisky from 1868, 1878, 1926, and 1939.

items.name: Rémy Martin Louis XIII
items.description: Iconic Cognac aged up to 100 years, a blend of 1,200 eaux-de-vie exclusively sourced from Grande Champagne. Presented in an exquisite Baccarat crystal decanter, representing the pinnacle of French luxury and craftsmanship.

items.name: Louis XIII Black Pearl Cognac
items.description: Ultra-exclusive cognac featuring a blend of 1,200 eaux-de-vie aged up to 100 years. Housed in a black crystal decanter by Baccarat, this represents the pinnacle of luxury spirits.

items.name: The Macallan - Tales of The Macallan - Volume I
items.description: An exceptionally rare single malt whisky, The Macallan - Tales of The Macallan - Volume I is a luxurious expression from the iconic Speyside producer. Bottled at 44.6% ABV, this release celebrates The Macallan's storied heritage. Presented in a bespoke Lalique crystal decanter and handcrafted book, this whisky is highly collectible and renowned for its opulence and complexity.
items.limitedEdition: Tales of The Macallan Volume I
items.notes: A true collector’s piece, limited to a select number of bottles worldwide and beautifully encased in a Lalique decanter with an artisanal book display. A showcase of Macallan’s dedication to tradition and craft. [Source](https://onshorecellars.com/collections/spirits/products/macallan-tales-of-the-macallan-volume-i?variant=47881969369412)

items.name: The Macallan - 78 yrs - Red Collection
items.description: An extraordinarily rare and luxurious single malt Scotch whisky from The Macallan, aged for 78 years and presented as part of the iconic Red Collection. This is the oldest release ever bottled by The Macallan. Its deep complexity, elegance, and astonishing depth are hallmarks of decades of maturation in The Macallan’s signature oak casks. The nose is rich with dried fruits, baked apple and polished oak; the palate is layered with sweet woodsmoke, plum, and raisin, all culminating in a lingering, sophisticated finish. Bottled at 42.2% ABV in Lalique crystal decanters.
items.notes: A masterpiece for whisky collectors, The Macallan 78 Red Collection is notable as one of the oldest and rarest expressions ever released by the distillery. Just a handful of bottles are available worldwide, each presented in hand-crafted Lalique crystal and an elegant display case. [Source](https://onshorecellars.com/collections/spirits/products/macallan-78-yrs-red-collection?variant=47882008887620)

items.name: Glenlivet - 55 yrs - The Eternal Collection
items.description: An exceptionally rare single malt Scotch whisky from Glenlivet, aged for 55 years and released as part of The Eternal Collection. This release offers extraordinary smoothness and complexity, with notes of rich dried fruits, honey, and subtle oak spice. Housed in an elegant decanter, making it a true collector’s masterpiece and testament to half a century of Speyside craftsmanship.
items.notes: Bottled at 55 years old, this Glenlivet is one of the oldest official expressions ever released from the distillery. Speyside’s legendary smooth style shines through: expect deep fruit, elegant oak, subtle florals, and a finish that lingers on the palate. Extremely limited availability.

items.name: Bowmore 1969 Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
items.description: Distilled in 1969, this extremely rare single malt has matured for over five decades in American Bourbon and Spanish Oloroso casks, resulting in a rich, unforgettable dram. Fruit and smoke flavours remain constant with increasing richness, epitomizing Islay single malt excellence.
items.notes: Aged in both American Bourbon and Spanish Oloroso casks for over 50 years, this single malt displays rich complexity and persistent fruit and smoke character. One of the rarest and most collectible Bowmore releases. [Source](https://www.lcbo.com/en/bowmore-1969-islay-single-malt-scotch-whisky-31964)

items.name: Highland Park 50-Year-Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
items.description: An ultra-rare, 50-year-old Orkney Island single malt artfully revealing the quality and refinement born from time and place. Crafted by master whisky maker Gordon Motion, this exquisitely aged whisky offers complexity, intensity, and richness—combining dried fruit, exotic spices, toast, and a gentle peat influence. Bottled in 2019, it stands as one of the most sought-after expressions for collectors and connoisseurs alike.
items.notes: This Highland Park 50-Year-Old is a testament to time, patience, and craftsmanship. The whisky is intense and rich, balancing complexity from dried fruit, exotic spice, gentle peat smoke, and the influence of exquisite casks. Released with very limited bottles worldwide. [Source](https://www.lcbo.com/en/highland-park-50-year-old-single-malt-scotch-whisky-10196)

items.name: Domaine d'Auvenay - Criots Batard-Montrachet - Grand Cru 2005
items.description: Domaine d’Auvenay’s 2005 Criots-Bâtard-Montrachet Grand Cru displays a vibrant golden hue, expressive aromas of orchard fruit, citrus zest, and toasted hazelnut. Rich yet precise, the palate reveals ripe peach, hints of brioche, flinty minerality, and lively acidity for a long, structured finish showing true grand cru pedigree.
items.notes: An extraordinary white Burgundy, this rare Grand Cru bottling is crafted entirely from Chardonnay and showcases excellence in complexity, texture, and balance, revered among collectors and connoisseurs alike. [Source](https://onshorecellars.com/collections/wine-1/products/domaine-dauvenay-criots-batard-montrachet-grand-cru?variant=54992420569468)

items.name: Domaine de la Romanée-Conti - Romanée-Conti Grand Cru 2014
items.description: The Domaine de la Romanée-Conti Romanée-Conti Grand Cru 2014 is one of the world's most revered wines, celebrated for its finesse, complexity, silken texture, and profound depth. Rarely available, this legendary Burgundy Pinot Noir comes from the iconic Romanée-Conti monopole vineyard, crafting a wine that epitomizes history, luxury, and a true sense of place. Aromas of rose petals, red berries, exotic spices, and earth are followed by a palate both elegant and precise, with an endless finish.
items.notes: Offered only in tiny allocations, Romanée-Conti represents the pinnacle of Pinot Noir. The 2014 vintage stands out for its perfumed bouquet, purity of fruit, and age-worthy structure—regarded as a must-have for serious collectors and Burgundy enthusiasts alike. [Source](https://onshorecellars.com/collections/wine-1/products/domaine-de-la-romanee-conti-romanee-conti-grand-cru?variant=43777186201825)

items.name: Château Petrus - 2006 - 300cl
items.description: One of the world’s most iconic wines, Château Petrus hails from the Pomerol appellation in Bordeaux. This 300cl bottle from the 2006 vintage is a monumental expression of Merlot, showing incredible depth, power, and elegance. Expect layers of ripe black fruit, notes of truffle, violet, rich earth, and a long, velvety finish. Extremely rare in this large format, highly prized by collectors.
items.notes: This legendary Bordeaux wine is crafted entirely from Merlot grapes grown on Petrus’s unique clay soils. The 2006 vintage displays power and finesse with concentrated fruit and a silken texture. This rare 300cl large-format bottle ensures optimal aging, coveted by fine wine enthusiasts and collectors. [Source](https://onshorecellars.com/collections/wine-1/products/chateau-petrus?variant=55479892410748)

items.description: Domaine de la Romanée-Conti La Tâche Grand Cru 1990 — legendary Pinot Noir from Burgundy. Offered as a 1.5L magnum via Sotheby's Wine (October Sale). 100 points Wine Advocate. Sale price $18,000 (list $24,995).

items.name: Dom Pérignon P2 2000
items.description: Ultra-premium champagne from Dom Pérignon's Plénitude series. This P2 represents the second peak of the wine's evolution, aged for 15 years on lees. Exceptional complexity and depth.

items.name: Domaine de la Romanée-Conti: La Tâche Grand Cru 1990
items.description: Legendary Burgundy Grand Cru Pinot Noir from Domaine de la Romanée-Conti's La Tâche vineyard, 1990 vintage. 100-point Wine Advocate wine famed for elegance, balance, and extraordinary aging potential. Produced in extremely limited quantities; highly collectible.

items.name: Yamazaki - 25 yrs
items.description: Indulge in the rich and complex flavours of Yamazaki 25-year-old whisky. Aged to perfection, this Japanese single malt boasts notes of honey, dried fruit and oak, with a smooth finish that lingers on the palate. Perfect for sipping and savouring, this rare and sought-after whisky is a true connoisseur's choice.
items.notes: A pinnacle of Japanese whisky craftsmanship, Yamazaki 25-Year-Old is celebrated for its exquisite depth and balance. Highly prized and extremely limited in availability. [Source](https://onshorecellars.com/collections/spirits/products/yamazaki-25-yrs?variant=46459599978820)

items.name: Hibiki 30 yrs
items.description: A legendary Japanese blended whisky, the Hibiki 30 Year Old is a superb showcase of Japanese craftsmanship. Matured for three decades, it offers a harmonious complexity of dried fruit, rich honey, sandalwood, exotic spices, and a delicate floral finish. Presented in an elegant 30-faceted bottle symbolizing the 30 years of maturation.
items.notes: Regarded as one of the world's greatest whiskies, Hibiki 30 Year Old is exceptionally rare and highly collectible. A masterpiece of blending, lauded for its elegance, balance and depth. [Source](https://onshorecellars.com/collections/spirits/products/hibiki-30yrs?variant=46465161691460)

items.name: The Brollach - Inaugural Release - Single Malt Irish Whiskey
items.description: Building on a legacy of handcrafted, record-breaking, award-winning whiskeys, The Brollach is an ultra-rare Single Malt and a true whiskey of a lifetime. Released on Father’s Day 2021 with only 661 bottles, it is a tribute to the unbreakable bond between father and son. Double-distilled and double-casked, The Brollach delivers exquisite depth and character. Honoring family, Ireland, and the rich heritage of Irish whiskey, it stands as a pinnacle of craftsmanship and tradition. Nose: Apricot, butterscotch, and velvety tarte tatin. Palate: Dark cherry with a hint of sourness that softens into dark chocolate. Finish: Caramelised banana that lingers in an oily, almost velvet-like mouthfeel.
items.notes: The Brollach is highly decorated, including a Master Medal at The Spirits Business Awards 2021 and Gold at The DBSB Autumn Tasting 2022. Presented in a natural oak case, this release includes two Finn glasses, a pipette, and whiskey stones. ABV: 46.44%. [Source](https://onshorecellars.com/collections/spirits/products/the-brollach-whiskey-2?variant=54903185703292)

items.name: Don Julio - Real - Añejo
items.description: Don Julio Real is the pinnacle of luxury in the Don Julio tequila range. As one of the few Extra-Añejo tequilas and a pioneer in the category, it is double-distilled from 100% blue weber agave and aged for 5 years in American white oak ex-bourbon casks. The result is an exceptionally smooth tequila, exuding aromas of citrus and sweet, cooked agave, followed by a velvet palate of vanilla, caramel, chocolate, and almond. Bottled in an ornate craft decanter, this is a masterpiece best enjoyed neat for life's finest moments.
items.notes: An ultra-premium Extra-Añejo tequila revered for its rich, layered profile and crafted only from the finest blue agave. Presented in an ornate bottle topped with a metal agave piña.

items.name: Glenlivet - 40 yrs
items.description: A tremendously rare 40-year-old Speyside single malt from the iconic Glenlivet distillery. Expertly matured over four decades, this limited release offers layers of rich dried fruits, honeyed oak, and subtle spices, with a finish of remarkable smoothness and length—an extraordinary showpiece of whisky craftsmanship.
items.notes: Matured in oak casks for four decades, Glenlivet 40 Year Old is highly collectible and revered for its balance of rich fruit, honey, and elegant spice. An ultra-rare dram for connoisseurs and investors alike. [Source](https://onshorecellars.com/collections/spirits/products/glenlivet-40-yrs-1?variant=55086826520956)

items.name: Glenfiddich - 40 yrs - Cumulative Time
items.description: An ultra-rare and exceptional 40-year-old single malt Scotch whisky from Glenfiddich, showcasing the pinnacle of Speyside whisky craftsmanship. The 'Cumulative Time' edition is meticulously vatted from select casks, blending decades of expertise, tradition, and innovation for a rich, layered, and memorable tasting experience.
items.notes: A showpiece Highland dram, matured for over four decades to achieve a perfect harmony of dried fruit, chocolate, sherry, light oak, and subtle spice. Bottled in extremely limited quantities, Glenfiddich 40yrs is a true collector's piece and a statement of Speyside single malt excellence. [Source](https://onshorecellars.com/collections/spirits/products/glenfiddich-40-yrs-cumulative-time?variant=47882093953348)

items.name: The Hakushu - 25 yrs
items.description: An ultra-rare and award-winning Japanese single malt whisky matured for 25 years in a combination of sherry and American white oak casks. Bottled at 43% ABV, it presents profound depth, layers of dried fruit, smoke, spice, and sweet oak. An astonishingly mature whisky of legendary status, crafted in the lush forests of the Japanese Alps. Ultra-limited, highly collectible, and a true symbol of Japanese whisky artistry.
items.notes: Awarded for its exceptional quality and rarity, The Hakushu 25 Year Old is a masterpiece of Japanese whisky, adored by connoisseurs for its layered depth, subtle smoke, and elegant long finish. [Source](https://onshorecellars.com/collections/spirits/products/the-hakushu-25ys?variant=47882022289732)

items.name: The Macallan - Decanter M
items.description: Part of The Macallan Masters Decanter Series, Decanter M is a rare and highly collectible single malt Scotch whisky, crafted to showcase The Macallan’s natural color and spectrum of flavor. Born from a collaboration of masters of their crafts, this unique spirit embodies elegance, complexity, and the essence of Speyside tradition.
items.notes: The Macallan Decanter M stands as a testament to innovation and artistry in whisky-making. Presented in a bespoke decanter and celebrated for its deep complexity with layers of dried fruit, spice, and oak. Bottled at 45% ABV. Very limited availability. [Source](https://onshorecellars.com/collections/spirits/products/macallan-decanter-m?variant=48460553584964)

items.name: The Macallan - 30 yrs - Double Cask - 2023 release
items.description: The Macallan 30 Years Old Double Cask 2023 release marries whisky matured in both American and European oak sherry-seasoned casks. The nose evokes aromas of fresh honeycomb, toffee, red apples, figs and vanilla pods, leading to a palate of cinnamon, ginger, Madagascan vanilla, dried fruits, and oak. At 43% ABV, this Speyside single malt offers a smooth, rich, and elegant experience. Limited and highly collectible.
items.notes: An extraordinary 30-year-old single malt combining the influence of American and European oak sherry casks for refined balance and complexity. Honeycomb, spices, oak, and dried fruit stand out in this rare bottling. Highly coveted among whisky collectors and enthusiasts. [Source](https://onshorecellars.com/collections/spirits/products/macallan-30-yrs-double-cask-2023-release?variant=48460539167044)

items.name: Talisker - 44 yrs - Forests of the Deep
items.description: Talisker 44 Years Old ‘Forests of the Deep’ is an ultra-rare single malt from the storied Talisker Distillery on the Isle of Skye. Matured for over four decades, this remarkable release boasts rich, maritime complexity layered with peaty smoke and deep oak. Bottled at cask strength, it pays tribute to the wild natural power of the sea and forest, presented in a stunning collectible decanter.
items.notes: A celebration of Talisker’s maritime legacy, ‘Forests of the Deep’ brings forth waves of sea spray, elegant smoke, tropical fruit, and complex oak. At 44 years old, this is one of the oldest and most limited bottlings from Talisker, cherished by collectors and connoisseurs alike. [Source](https://onshorecellars.com/collections/spirits/products/talisker-44-yrs-forests-of-the-deep-1?variant=47884414681412)

items.name: Domaine Leroy: Romanee-Saint-Vivant, Grand Cru 1988
items.description: An immensely rare Burgundy Grand Cru Pinot Noir from Domaine Leroy's Romanee-Saint-Vivant vineyard, vintage 1988. Highly sought-after by collectors for its fine, elegant structure, remarkable aging potential, and intense aromatics. Critically acclaimed with 93 points from Wine Advocate and 95-98 points from Vinous.
items.notes: One of Burgundy's legendary Grand Crus, from a vintage known for elegance, structure and finesse. Outstanding provenance and quality.

items.name: Krug - Clos d'Ambonnay - Blanc de Noirs - Brut 2006
items.description: The 2006 Krug Clos d'Ambonnay is a legendary Champagne produced exclusively from Pinot Noir grapes grown in the tiny, walled Clos d'Ambonnay vineyard. This single-vineyard, single-vintage Blanc de Noirs is celebrated for its intense concentration and remarkable depth. It displays exceptional purity of fruit, flavors of red berries, brioche, and citrus, with complex toasty and nutty notes from extended lees aging. Immensely rare and collectible, this cult bottling exemplifies the pinnacle of prestige Champagne craftsmanship.
items.notes: Among the rarest and most revered Champagnes, this single-vineyard 2006 Blanc de Noirs reveals legendary concentration, finesse, and aging potential. Red fruits, pastry, and subtle mineral notes intermingle on a creamy, persistent palate. A true collector's icon. [Source](https://onshorecellars.com/collections/sparkling/products/krug-clos-dambonnay?variant=55037909991804)

items.name: Domaine de la Romanée-Conti - Marc de Bourgogne - Eau-de-Vie
items.description: An ultra-rare and collectible eaux-de-vie from the legendary Domaine de la Romanée-Conti. Distilled from the grape pomace of the famous Burgundy Grand Cru vineyards, this Marc de Bourgogne offers profound purity, finesse, and intense aromatics with a smooth, elegant finish. Bottled in 2000 and presented in a 75cl format, it remains a gem for connoisseurs and collectors.
items.notes: A highly allocated spirit from Burgundy’s most prestigious domaine, distilled from prized Grand Cru marc. Revered for its rarity and enjoyed for its remarkable clarity and depth. [Source](https://onshorecellars.com/collections/spirits/products/domaine-de-la-romanee-conti-marc-de-bourgogne-eau-de-vie?variant=47852668911940)

items.name: Martell - L’Or de Jean Martell - Cognac
items.description: An exceptional cognac from Maison Martell, L’Or de Jean Martell is the ultimate expression of 300 years of savoir-faire. Composed of more than 400 very old eaux-de-vie from the Grande Champagne and Borderies terroirs, its aromatic complexity features notes of citrus, black berries, gingerbread, clove, cinnamon, vanilla, and oriental woods. The blend's structure and power extend into a flavorful, persistent finish.
items.notes: Features an ornate decanter and a rich, harmonious bouquet with citrus, berry, spice, and rancio character. The very old Grande Champagne eaux-de-vie give the blend aromatic power, structure, and a lengthy, persistent finish. [Source](https://onshorecellars.com/collections/spirits/products/martell-l-or-de-jean-martell-cognac-1?variant=55086744994172)

items.name: Salon 'S' Le Mesnil - Blanc de Blancs - 2007 Magnum
items.description: Salon 'S' Le Mesnil is famed for being produced only in exceptional vintages, showcasing the purest expression of Chardonnay from Le Mesnil-sur-Oger. The 2007 Magnum embodies precision, tension, and the signature mineral elegance of Salon, with a depth and racy acidity that evolves gracefully in large format. Renowned for its fine mousse, vibrant citrus, and crisp green apple notes, underpinned by chalky minerality and subtle toasty complexity. A legendary Champagne for true collectors.
items.notes: The 2007 vintage is celebrated for its balance and purity. Magnum format enhances aging and complexity. With vivacious acidity, ultra-fine bubbles, and dazzling minerality, this is among Champagne’s greatest white wines. [Source](https://onshorecellars.com/collections/sparkling/products/salon-s-le-mesnil-blanc-de-blancs?variant=55479816847740)

items.name: Clase Azul Ultra
items.description: Clase Azul Tequila Ultra is an extraordinary collector's decanter and ultra-premium tequila, crafted over nearly 14 years. Produced from 100% blue agave and aged for five years in American whiskey and Spanish sherry casks, it boasts a rich dark amber hue with copper highlights. The aroma is marked by sherry, dried plums, apricot, maple syrup, and hazelnut, while the palate is treated to flavors of dried plums, cinnamon, crème caramel, vanilla, and crystallized ginger. Each unique decanter is exquisitely hand-painted by master artisans using platinum and silver, making this a true treasure for connoisseurs and collectors alike.
items.notes: Features a platinum-feather design, painted freehand by skilled artisans. Award-winning and exceptionally rare, Clase Azul Ultra represents the pinnacle of artisanal tequila and luxury spirits. [Source](https://onshorecellars.com/collections/spirits/products/clase-azul-ultra?variant=43739103297761)

items.name: Nikka - IX - The Nine Decades - 90th Anniversary
items.description: A commemorative single malt celebrating Nikka's 90th anniversary. Rich apple pie and raisin sweetness, toasty barrel-ageing notes, and gentle smokiness blend with nostalgic hints of antique furniture. Complex, layered aromas evoke a peaceful whisky warehouse. Mellow oak with depth forms a base, structuring spicy cinnamon, roasted nuts, and dark chocolate notes. Balanced peat bitterness with sweet apricot jam and maple syrup, finishing warm and inviting.
items.notes: Single malt, 48% ABV, 70cl. Celebrates nine decades of Nikka's craftsmanship with rare depth and complexity. [Source](https://onshorecellars.com/collections/spirits/products/nikka-ix-the-nine-decades-90th-anniversary-1?variant=55073659552124)

items.name: Ladyburn - 42 yrs - Vintage 1973
items.description: Ladyburn 42 Years Old is an extremely rare single malt from the closed Lowland distillery Ladyburn, which was in operation for only nine years. The whisky was distilled in March 1973 and aged for 42 years before being bottled in July 2015. Ladyburn 42 Years Old has a unique, beautifully balanced flavour profile. On the nose, expect deep aromas of linseed oil, subtle vanilla oak, fresh fruits, polished wood and leather. The palate is rich and mouthcoating with notes of stewed fruits, dried orange, prune and antique leather. The finish is long and slightly dry with lingering hints of chocolate, spices and oak.

items.notes: Distilled in March 1973 and bottled in July 2015. ABV: 40%. Single malt from the Lowland region. Tasting notes include linseed oil, vanilla oak, fruit, wood, leather, stewed fruits, dried orange, prune, chocolate, spices, and oak. [Source](https://onshorecellars.com/collections/spirits/products/ladyburn-42-yrs-vintage-1974?variant=46836808089924)

items.name: Hennessy - 250 ans
items.description: Cognac Hennessy 250 ans is a luxurious blend created to celebrate the 250th anniversary of the prestigious Hennessy house. This exceptional cognac boasts a rich and complex taste profile that begins with an inviting bouquet of candied fruit, spice, and a subtle hint of toasted oak. On the palate, it reveals layers of flavor, starting with sweet notes of dried apricot, fig, and honey, followed by a warming wave of cinnamon, nutmeg, and vanilla. The finish is long and smooth, leaving a lingering impression of soft caramel and a touch of dark chocolate. Ideal for special occasions and collectors.
items.notes: Created to celebrate the 250th anniversary of the Hennessy house, this cognac delivers candied fruit, spice, toasted oak, dried apricot, fig, honey, cinnamon, nutmeg, vanilla, soft caramel, and dark chocolate. [Source](https://onshorecellars.com/collections/spirits/products/hennessy-250-ans?variant=48726734831940)

items.name: Havana Club Maximo Extra Anejo
items.description: Havana Club Máximo Extra Añejo is the ultimate expression of Cuban rum. Handcrafted by blending the oldest and finest rum reserves matured in Havana Club’s cellars, this exclusive spirit is produced in just 1,000 bottles each year. Intense yet elegant, it offers aromas of oak, smoke, fresh pear, coconut and dried fruit. Its silky palate delivers layers of dark chocolate, dried fruit, vanilla, and a warm, spicy finish—a true embodiment of Cuba's rum legacy.
items.notes: Tasting profile: Amber glow, rich and persistent aromatics, balancing oak and smoky notes with hints of fresh pear, coconut, and dried fruit. The palate is both dry and sweet, delivering silky opulence and notes of dark chocolate, dried fruit, and vanilla with a spicy, warming finish. Produced in only 1,000 bottles annually, it is the pinnacle of Cuban rum culture. [Source](https://onshorecellars.com/collections/spirits/products/havana-club-maximo-extra-anejo-rum?variant=43706197147873)

items.name: Caol Ila 32 Year Old Single Cask #6223 (Wu Dram Clan, Bram, Floris & Pierrick)
items.description: A 32-year-old Islay single malt from Caol Ila Distillery, matured in a single cask and selected by Wu Dram Clan, Bram, Floris & Pierrick. The palate offers a rich, oily texture with pronounced coastal flavors such as iodine, smoked oysters, and brine, alongside green, peppery nuances and crushed sea salt. Fruity notes of grapefruit, lime, and apple balance tart and mineral elements for a clean, long, and focused finish with forward-moving smoke, coastal salinity, and lingering fruity nuances.

items.name: Caspian Sea Almas Osetra Caviar
items.description: Exceptionally rare, these large, strikingly light, bright eggs offer a unique tasting opportunity, as Almas is seldom available. Almas caviar presents a delicate palate with extremely elegant and mild flavor and subtle richness.

items.name: Special Reserve® Kaluga Huso Hybrid
items.description: Kaluga-Huso is a naturally-occurring hybrid combining the rich flavors of Beluga caviar with a clean, buttery burst, firm beads and a velvet finish. This decadent masterpiece is perfect for those who prefer butter to brine.

items.name: Special Reserve® Ossetra Caviar
items.description: Special Reserve® Ossetra represents the pinnacle of Ossetra caviar, selected from only the finest batches. It offers a rich, briny, and lingering flavor with a sublime symphony of taste and texture, ideal for true connoisseurs.

items.name: Special Reserve® Alverta Caviar
items.description: Special Reserve® Alverta is matured to perfection, offering a nutty flavor, soft lingering finish, and a rare touch of sweetness amid briny notes. Ideal for connoisseurs seeking a bold and unique caviar experience.

items.name: Almas Albino Caviar
items.description: Produced only by an extremely rare Albino Beluga Sturgeon, Almas is the ultimate and world’s highest value caviar. The name 'Almas' translates from Persian as 'Diamonds', referencing the appearance of the eggs. These Huso Huso Albino Sturgeon inhabit the southern Caspian Sea and are about 60 years old when harvested. Albino Almas caviar is extremely rare, sometimes only available every 5–10 years, and can command prices up to £40,000 per kilogram. Imperial Caviar ensures authenticity by never substituting inferior yellow caviar.

items.name: Jamón Ibérico de Bellota Bone-In by 5J
items.description: 5J (Cinco Jotas) Jamón Ibérico de Bellota is one of the world’s most exceptional and prestigious hams. Crafted exclusively from 100% purebred Ibérico pigs roaming the dehesas of Spain's Sierra de Aracena, these pigs feed on acorns and wild herbs during the Montanera season, resulting in signature marbling and the profound, complex flavors characteristic of true acorn-fed jamón ibérico. Each ham is hand-salted and slowly aged in historic cellars under the mastery of artisanal curing experts, culminating in a culinary work of art with layered notes of acorn, hazelnut, wildflowers, and a silky, umami-rich finish. A global icon of Spanish gastronomy.

items.name: Prunier Osciètre Héritage
items.description: An iconic and rare Osciètre caviar representing only 1 percent of Prunier’s annual production. Features slightly larger grains with a creamy texture that melts on the palate, offering delicate and complex flavors. Known for its golden brown color, the lightest in the Prunier Osciètre line. Produced from Acipenser gueldenstaedtii sturgeon, raised for over 12 years in France before harvesting.

items.name: Takamori Drunken Wagyu A5 Whole Beef Ribeye

items.name: Caviar House Finest Caviar Beluga Vacuum Tin
items.description: Beluga caviar sourced exclusively from the Huso Huso sturgeon. Known for its very large grains and pearl grey color, it offers a rich creamy texture, full-bodied taste, pronounced iodine character, and a long lingering finish. Considered one of the most exceptional and luxurious caviars available.

items.name: Jamón Ibérico Bellota Whole Leg
items.description: Montaraz's Jamón Ibérico de Bellota is a stunning centerpiece made from free-range 100% Ibérico pigs, exclusively fed on acorns and grass during the Montanera season. This age-old delicacy is cured using only salt and patience, resulting in decadently buttery and nutty flavors, beautifully marbled fat, and a unique melt-in-your-mouth texture. Crafted using traditional methods passed down for four generations, this jamón offers a truly luxurious gastronomic experience.

items.description: An Italian delicacy made from the prized milk of Vacche Rosse Reggiane cows. Known for a sweet and persistent flavor, straw yellow color, rich aroma, and better digestibility compared to traditional Parmigiano Reggiano.

items.name: Piedmont Alba White Truffles

Includes one 1.75 oz Beluga Hybrid Caviar, one 1.75 oz Kaluga Osetra Caviar, and one 1.75 oz Karat Russian Osetra Caviar. items.name: Prosciutto di Parma PDO 30 Months Whole With Bone In Wooden Box
items.description: An Italian charcuterie masterpiece aged for 30 months in the hills of Parma. Presented whole with bone and housed in an elegant wooden box. items.description: A salmon colored cuvée noted for its balance and aromatic range with characteristic Pinot Noir notes. The blend consists of Pinots from the Côte des Bars and Vallée de la Marne, Chardonnays from Vertus, Nogent l'Abbesse, Vert Toulon, and Grauves, plus a small portion of red champagne from Pinots. Aged 18 to 24 months in bottle, it combines the elegance and freshness of Chardonnay with the cherry complexity contributed by Pinot Noir.

items.name: Perigord Black Winter Truffles
items.description: The finest and most concentrated of all the black truffles, often referred to as black diamonds, sourced from the dark rich soil of the renowned Perigord region of France. Known for fragrant aromatics and a rich yet sweet earthy flavor profile, perfect for Fall and Winter cookery. Available fresh from December to February while in season.

items.name: Olympia Provisions Landrauchschinken
items.description: Olympia Provisions Landrauchschinken is a traditional German-style smoked and dry-cured ham, crafted in Portland by Olympia Provisions. This artisan delicacy is slowly cured, gently smoked over apple and hickory wood, and aged to develop deep, smoky flavor and a tender, silky texture. Sliced paper thin, it’s perfect for charcuterie boards and gourmet sandwiches. A favorite among cured-meat connoisseurs.

items.name: White Truffle Moliterno
items.description: White Truffle Moliterno is a decadent Italian sheep’s milk cheese shot through with rich seams of earthy white truffle. The wheels are aged before being injected with black and white truffle paste, adding deep, savory, and garlicky notes to the nutty, crystalline Moliterno. Its striking marbling and bold aroma make it a luxurious centerpiece for cheese boards and truffle lovers alike.

items.name: Tête de Moine Whole Wheel
items.description: Tête de Moine is a semi-hard Swiss cheese made from raw cow's milk. Originally produced by monks of Bellelay Abbey in the Jura Mountains, it is mildly funky with light, fruity flavors. Traditionally served in delicate 'flowers' using a girolle, it pairs beautifully with fruity dessert wines.

items.name: Olympia Provisions Mortadella
items.description: Olympia Provisions Mortadella is an authentic Italian-style mortadella, slow-roasted and delicately seasoned. Crafted using traditional techniques, it features finely ground pork studded with rich cubes of creamy fat for a silky texture and irresistible flavor. Perfect for gourmet sandwiches, antipasto platters, or as a luxurious charcuterie addition.

items.name: Truffle Brie
items.description: Truffle Brie sets a decadent triple crème at the intersection of rich French cheese and earthy, aromatic truffles. Plush, creamy brie is split and layered with a lush truffle cream, making for an indulgent bite with deep, garlicky truffle notes and buttery undertones. A centerpiece-worthy addition to any cheese board and perfect for special occasions.

items.name: Vacherin Mont d'Or
items.description: Vacherin Mont d'Or is a legendary French raw cow's milk cheese prized for its luscious, gooey texture and unmistakable woodsy character. Ripened in a spruce bark belt, the cheese develops earthy, resinous notes and a rich, creamy mouthfeel. Traditionally served warm by oven baking in its wooden box, it's a winter delicacy that pairs beautifully with bread and white wine.

items.name: San Giuliano Lemon Marmalade
items.description: Hand-crafted in Sicily using estate-grown lemons from the San Giuliano estate, this marmalade is gently cooked to preserve the vibrant flavor and aroma of fresh lemons. Sweet and tart, it’s perfect for pairing with cheese, toast, pastries, or as a refined accent for desserts and breakfast spreads.

items.description: A stunning collector’s edition grand piano paying homage to Hokusai’s iconic 'The Great Wave off Kanagawa.' items.description: An exceedingly rare, fully illuminated Book of Hours (HORAE) created in Amiens around 1490, featuring 24 small calendar miniatures, 4 smaller miniatures, and 17 full-page miniatures amid burlesque borders. Each page is meticulously illuminated, populated with grotesques, dragons, dwarfs, musicians, satyrs, mermaids, chimeras, and scenes evoking both secular and spiritual life of the Netherlands during the Dukes of Burgundy. Distinguished for its eccentric artistry and vibrant evocation of 15th-century life, this collectible stands as a museum-worthy artifact and a masterpiece of late medieval illumination.

items.description: A beautifully executed and unusual Parisian Book of Hours illuminated around 1400–1410. Painted at the time of the Duke of Berry, with 15 large miniatures attributed to the Master of the Bible Historiale fr. 159. Contains 224 folios, richly decorated with burnished gold, pink, and blue initials, elaborate borders with ivyleaf infill, and highly detailed miniatures. Originally commissioned for a French noblewoman, its provenance passes through several prominent French families and antiquarian collections. items.description: A life-sized, hand-coloured photograph of the celebrated Fra Mauro mappamundi, originally drawn around 1450 and widely hailed as the greatest achievement in medieval cartography. Created ca. 1871 by Italian photographer Carlo Naya in Venice, this monumental print (223 x 223 cm) reproduces the world map in full scale, capturing its hundreds of illustrations and thousands of descriptive texts. Naya’s photograph marked a pioneering moment in art history and large-format photography. Fra Mauro’s map, oriented with south at the top, represents both a scientific masterpiece and a bridge between medieval and Renaissance worldviews. Only a handful of these photographs are known to exist in major libraries and museums.
